concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-stored-value-api]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured JSON-only Stored Value API overview for gift-card management operations, provider/channel matrix, SVS legacy-issuing exception and result codes; source separates payment APIs and flags matrix conflicts.
warnings: Overview online matrix checks SVS activation/activation+load, while 2020-modified status-change child online matrix crosses all providers for those operations; no reconciliation in captures.
Supported-card list names Intersolve/SVS/Fiserv but matrix also includes Givex; SVS issue row crossed yet legacy existing integrations may continue issuing.
Stored Value API excludes making, cancelling and refunding payments; void is limited to Stored Value API transaction from prior 24 hours and is not a payment-refund guarantee.
